lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.script: The Portal Stone took them in a heartbeat — and spat them out on a mountain at the edge of the world.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.script: Below Chaendaer lay the Three-fold Land. And under a dome of fog, a city no outsider was meant to see.

lines.speaker: RILEY
lines.script: She came through here. I can feel it.

lines.speaker: MOIRAINE
lines.script: Rhuidean. Step carefully. Something in that city is awake.

lines.speaker: LAN
lines.script: Shadowspawn tracks. Fresh. Stay on my left.

lines.speaker: LAN
lines.script: Down! Brace against it!

lines.speaker: RILEY
lines.script: Can't see a thing in this!

lines.speaker: MOIRAINE
lines.script: The veil. Whatever you see in there, keep moving.

lines.speaker: RILEY
lines.script: The ground's moving!

lines.speaker: ASMODEAN
lines.script: A boy with a borrowed sword, chasing a girl he'll never find. Shall I play you a dirge?

lines.speaker: ASMODEAN
lines.script: Listen — even the glass sings for me.

lines.speaker: ASMODEAN
lines.script: Do you know what this is? Of course you don't.

lines.speaker: ASMODEAN
lines.script: You — you dare?!

lines.speaker: RILEY
lines.script: Off-key.

lines.speaker: RILEY
lines.script: Moiraine!

lines.speaker: RILEY
lines.script: Lan — now!

lines.speaker: RILEY
lines.script: I need you!

lines.speaker: MOIRAINE
lines.script: Stand aside.

lines.speaker: MOIRAINE
lines.script: The Light shield you.

lines.speaker: LAN
lines.script: Behind me.

lines.speaker: LAN
lines.script: Now, sheepherder— now!

lines.speaker: MOIRAINE
lines.script: Lan!

lines.speaker: ASMODEAN
lines.script: Enough! Enough… I yield. The Fades sold the girl to women in shawls — a Tower embassy, riding for Cairhien.

lines.speaker: MOIRAINE
lines.script: He will keep. A shielded Forsaken is still worth more than a dead one.

lines.speaker: LAN
lines.script: Cairhien, then. We ride at dawn.

lines.speaker: RILEY
lines.script: Hold on. I'm coming.
